description: Source code for a dummy display driver implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, and capabilities functions.

methods.name: dummy_display_init
methods.description: Initializes the dummy display device, setting default pixel format.

methods.description: Handles writing pixel data to the display, with boundary checks.

methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities and supported pixel formats.
